description: This is a Grunt configuration file used for automating build tasks such as cleaning, concatenating, minifying, compressing, copying files, and generating documentation for the FooTable project.

methods.name: grunt.initConfig
methods.description: Initializes the configuration for various build tasks such as clean, concat, uglify, cssmin, compress, copy, and jsdoc.

methods.name: grunt.loadNpmTasks
methods.description: Loads external Grunt plugins required for tasks like cleaning, concatenating, minifying, compressing, copying, and generating documentation.

methods.name: grunt.registerTask
methods.description: Defines composite tasks like 'default', 'package', and 'jsdocs' that run sequences of individual tasks.
